title: Declare fixed and varying harness experiment dimensions
narrative: Taloneth needs every harness experiment to state which configuration axes are fixed and which vary, with a reproducible digest on traces. Accepts FineEnvs harness-overfitting axes guidance[^fineenvs-dims].
implementation: `ExperimentDimensions` and `require_dimension_trace_fields` in `mechaharness.experiment_dimensions` canonicalize fixed/varying axes into a digest.
validation: Kind `experiment_dimensions_digest`. Soft expects digest present. Unit tests in `tests/test_experiment_dimensions.py`.
